name: SensorReading
description: Telemetry reading from an embedded sensor node, serialized in postcard wire format

fields.name: humidity_pct_x10
fields.description: Relative humidity in tenths of percent (e.g., 650 = 65.0%)

fields.name: status
fields.description: Device status as a unit variant enum

fields.name: sub_readings
fields.description: Variable-length sequence of auxiliary sensor readings

encoding_notes.integer_encoding: u16, u32, u64 use unsigned varint (LEB128). i16, i32 use zigzag encoding before varint.
encoding_notes.enum_encoding: Discriminant encoded as varint(u32). Unit variants have no following data. Variant indices: Ok=0, Warning=1, Error=2, Calibrating=3.
encoding_notes.seq_encoding: Prefixed by varint(usize) element count, followed by that many individually encoded elements.
encoding_notes.struct_encoding: Fields encoded in declaration order with no separators, no field names, no length prefix.
encoding_notes.framing: Each serialized message is COBS-encoded (sentinel=0x00) and terminated by a 0x00 delimiter byte.
